## Checklist

- [ ] The resource offers a genuine free tier (not just a free trial), or is open source.
- [ ] `frontend/public/resources.json` is valid (`npm run validate`).
- [ ] No duplicate URL (the validator checks by normalized full path).
- [ ] Description includes the actual free limits.
- [ ] Entry has 2–10 tags, each 2–20 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens.
